title: mhtsec/ARTEX
why_read: An award-winning autonomous AI penetration-testing framework, technically interesting but also a dual-use offensive security tool worth noting rather than excluding.
analysis: ARTEX is described as an AI-driven autonomous penetration testing system, written in Go, which won a Baidu-sponsored 'agent+' offense/defense competition. Autonomous pentesting agents are a genuinely active and important security research area, since they can help defenders find vulnerabilities faster, though the same capability can be misused for unauthorized attacks. Given it's a competition-winning open research project rather than a tool explicitly marketed for malicious use, it's reasonable to include with a note about its dual-use nature rather than exclude it outright.
